nodes.name: Starstone Assay
nodes.description: Grade the friendly teal glow by weight, warmth, and how long it keeps its promise.

nodes.name: Half-Life Dials
nodes.description: Give every fading field a teal face so the town can read what time will mend.

nodes.name: Isotope Kitchen
nodes.description: Set lead glass, tong arms, and a repurposed pie case around each measured sample.
nodes.effect: Banks the Isotope Kitchen refining family.

nodes.name: Decay Clockwork
nodes.description: Put buffs, puddles, and tired machines on one honest town clock.

nodes.name: Calculating House Ledgers
nodes.description: Join telegraph receipts, starstone counts, and the Prospector's old plate into one civic charter.
nodes.effect: Banks the Calculating House founding pattern.

nodes.name: Sunline Beam
nodes.description: Turn warm light through a brass dish instead of asking powder to do the work.
nodes.effect: Banks the Sunline beam arsenal family.

nodes.name: Half-Life Caltrops
nodes.description: Scatter fading starstone pips that slow a charge, then politely go dark.

nodes.name: Sunline Mount
nodes.description: Set a parabolic mirror on the familiar sentry tripod without changing its footing.

nodes.name: Glow Fence
nodes.description: Seat measured starstone pips in the old guardrail and let the light fade by the ledger.
nodes.effect: Banks the Glow Fence building tier.

nodes.name: Homemaker-9000 Components
nodes.description: A future Homemaker medal will release the vacuum arm, toast rack, and chrome-core diagrams.
nodes.effect: Banks the Homemaker-9000 component science behind the reserved homemakerComponentsCaptured medal flag.

nodes.name: Atomic Parts
nodes.description: Assay enamel housings, dial glass, tong joints, and starstone sockets as typed parts.

nodes.name: Copper Lasso
nodes.description: Braid a gentle conducting loop for appliances that have run themselves quiet.

nodes.name: Herd Receipts
nodes.description: Mark which shepherd drove which herd and where every pacified helper came to rest.

nodes.name: Appliance Pen
nodes.description: Give captured helpers a numbered corral, a tether post, and useful work after the wave.

nodes.name: Defector's Catalog
nodes.description: Cross out every promise that failed and keep the useful Combine patterns under honest names.
nodes.effect: Banks the catalog-pattern family for the future Exchange.
